answer: Defense: a superlinear identity bond. Each new agent locks collateral scaling with the square of how many identities one funding source already controls, so the first costs 100 tokens but 1,000 sybils cost up to 100,000 each, a total that swells like a river, not a flat stream. An attacker tries to reset the curve with fresh wallets, yet shared on-chain funding links them back to one cedar-deep root and the bond ripples upward again. Faking 1,000 peers becomes economically crushing while one honest agent pays little.
